description: Writes computed FrozenBounds into config/parameters.toml's [enrichment.complexity_bounds] and [analysis] sections, preserving every other existing value in the file byte-for-byte outside the touched keys.
signature: def write_parameters_toml_section(path: Path, bounds: FrozenBounds) -> None
docstring:
Write frozen bounds into parameters.toml.

Args:
    path: Path to config/parameters.toml.
    bounds: compute_frozen_bounds' output.

Returns:
    None. Performs an in-place, minimally-invasive update: parses the existing TOML, sets/overwrites exactly the complexity_bounds sub-keys and the tag_distance_threshold key, and re-serializes -- using a round-trip-preserving TOML library (e.g. tomlkit, not tomllib+re-dump-from-scratch) so comments and key ordering elsewhere in the file survive.

Raises:
    ParameterError: If the resulting file would fail config.validate_parameters (defensive re-validation before committing the write, so this script cannot silently produce a parameters.toml that config itself would then reject at the next run's startup).
preconditions: path exists and is currently valid TOML (should already be true since this script's whole purpose is to update an existing, working parameters.toml)
postconditions: config.load_parameters(path) succeeds and reflects the new bounds after this call
Every other section/key in the file is byte-identical to before the call except the touched keys

edge_cases.input: parameters.toml already has a [enrichment.complexity_bounds] section with old values
edge_cases.expected_behavior: old values are overwritten, not appended alongside

edge_cases.input: The resulting file would fail config.validate_parameters (e.g. a computed bound pair is somehow degenerate despite compute_frozen_bounds' own guard)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: raises ParameterError and does NOT write the file (write is all-or-nothing, validated in memory before touching disk)

unit_tests.name: test_updates_only_targeted_keys
unit_tests.description: A fixture parameters.toml with unrelated sections and comments retains them byte-identical after the call, with only the bounds/threshold keys changed.
unit_tests.expected: diff shows only the targeted keys changed

unit_tests.name: test_invalid_result_not_written
unit_tests.description: A bounds object that would produce an invalid file raises ParameterError and leaves the original file untouched.
